contracts.lane_identity: Exactly one C0 through C7 record per pair, in declared order.
contracts.map_semantics: A complete moving-to-fixed map is scored directly. A residual-after-supplied-affine map is evaluated as residual(affine(moving point)); its effective identity hashes the composition contract and both component identities.
contracts.scoring: Independent world landmarks and future labels are primary. Method losses remain separately named secondary diagnostics.
contracts.controls: Every lane records objective, support, mask, model freedom, initialization source and frozen recipient control identity.
contracts.cost: Canonical inputs load once. Shared input read/decompression, per-lane cold standalone input/preparation, actual shared preparation, method stages, work counts and retained bytes remain distinct.
contracts.failures: Input failure, adapter failure, typed method failure and unavailable or conditional lanes remain rows in the eight-lane denominator.

validation.schema_validation: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema passed plus exact ordered C0-C7 and independent-score semantic checks.

claim_boundary: This qualifies the comparison evidence machinery and analytic map semantics. It does not admit a HalfFlow baseline, nonlinear image adapter, transfer, shared primitive, MRI accuracy result, or method superiority.
